component.name: Clipboard History
component.summary: مدیر کلیپ‌بورد مدرن برای لینوکس با الهام از ویندوز ۱۱

description.p: A fast, bilingual clipboard manager for Linux (Wayland & X11), inspired by the Windows 11 Win+V clipboard experience. Built with Tauri v2, React 19, and Rust for maximum performance and security.
مدیر کلیپ‌بورد سریع و دوزبانه برای لینوکس (Wayland و X11) با الهام از تجربه Win+V ویندوز ۱۱. ساخته شده با Tauri v2، React 19 و Rust.

ul.li: Super+V / Ctrl+Alt+V shortcut to open clipboard history
Persian (فارسی) + English Setup and Settings; stable English/LTR main popup
Pin important items, emoji picker, kaomoji, and symbols
Local SQLite history with secret filter and privacy controls
Acrylic/glass UI with light, dark, and system theme support
Image clipboard support with thumbnail previews
Fully offline: bundled Vazirmatn font, zero network calls at runtime

description.p: Enterprise 2.5: live blocking CI/release, main-window paste ACL, encrypted images, gif-search compile-time isolation, shared IP policy.
Enterprise hardening: fail-closed history crypto, paged IPC by default, GIF HTTP behind a compile feature, blocking CI/release supply-chain gates.

ul.li: Fail-closed field encryption; paste tickets on every paste command
Blocking CI tests, coverage, cargo/npm audit
SHA256SUMS, SPDX SBOM, and SLSA provenance on GitHub Releases

description.p: Paste tickets, IPC truncation, ChaCha20-Poly1305 history encryption.

ul.li: Fully offline (bundled Vazirmatn font, tightened CSP)
Mandatory SHA256SUMS verification in the installer
Blocking dependency audits in CI + coverage gate + smoke tests
SLSA build provenance and SPDX SBOM published per release

description.p: SQLite persistence, privacy filters (secrets + password-manager skip), SSRF protection with DNS pinning, bilingual UI, and multi-distro packaging (deb/rpm/AppImage/AUR/Flatpak).
